headline: Chip stock investors beware — these charts could warn of further weakness ahead
detail: This headline directly warns of potential weakness in the chip sector. Given your 90% concentration in tech/chip names and trading on margin, any further downturn in this sector would significantly amplify your losses.
rec: Consider reviewing your leveraged chip positions like SOXL and SPAL for potential trims to reduce exposure to further downside. Tighten stops on SMH.
